our_interpretation: This is a publication-date index-exposure calculation, not a forecast that the hypothetical selloff will occur.
The ordinary reading compares percentage index losses with the April 14, 2000 session identified immediately before the sentence.
Apply a simultaneous 20% decline to the named constituents while holding other constituents unchanged. Additional contagion is not specified.
Test the Nasdaq Composite and S&P 500 separately. Nasdaq-100 weights cannot substitute for Composite weights.
The sentence excludes Microsoft, while its heading includes Microsoft. Both baskets require separate calculations.
Use the October 20, 2026 publication-date snapshot. The source does not identify an intraday timestamp or a numerical tolerance for 'around' and 'same'.
criteria.support_condition: Independently verified publication-date weights imply approximately the cited historical percentage losses when the named basket falls about 20%, with any Microsoft-dependent difference disclosed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified publication-date weights imply materially different index losses under both reasonable basket readings, or show that the claimed equivalence depends on substituting a different index.
